recentItems.title: Macaulay Culkin Honors Catherine O’Hara in Gut-Wrenching In Memoriam | 2026 Emmys
recentItems.description:
Macaulay Culkin shared a heartstring-tugging tribute to his late costar after his 'Home Alone' costar Catherine O'Hara's January death, taking the stage alongside her 'Schitt’s Creek' costars Annie Murphy and Dan Levy to begin the in memoriam segment. "We remember her as the forgetful mother," Culkin began. "But I will never forget about her. There are all kinds of words I could use to describe Catherine. She was encouraging. She was warm. She was funny. But the word that I think of is mama." Culkin said, "She was my mom. She was our mama, and by extension, she's all of her mama. By the way, call your mother tonight, for real. But like a good mama, she always showed up when I asked her to, because that was Catherine. That's what she did. She showed up, and this is the best that we can do for her tonight." Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435942/emmys-2026-macaulay-culkin-honors-catherine-ohara-for-in-memoriam
